description: modules/identityaccess — POST /auth/session/validate without a refresh token, which the BFF asks on every page view (#5399). One administrative transaction (BEGIN, SET LOCAL ROLE, ..., COMMIT) reads the family, the account and the facts its refresh decides, each once, without row locks and without claims. Facts: the Träger memberships, the Träger roles (right "In OGS wechseln") and the school of the Träger.
